name: list_clusters
description: Discover all Amazon Redshift provisioned clusters and serverless workgroups. Call this first to get cluster_identifier and cluster_type for the other tools.

name: list_databases
description: List databases in a Redshift cluster or serverless workgroup.

cluster_type.description: Cluster type reported by list_clusters: provisioned or serverless.

database_name.description: Database to connect to for metadata discovery. Defaults to dev.

cluster_type.description: Cluster type reported by list_clusters: provisioned or serverless.

schema_database_name.description: Database name to list schemas for.

name: list_tables
description: List tables and views in a schema.

cluster_type.description: Cluster type reported by list_clusters: provisioned or serverless.

table_schema_name.description: Schema name to list tables for.

name: list_columns
description: List columns of a table with data types and nullability.

cluster_type.description: Cluster type reported by list_clusters: provisioned or serverless.

column_table_name.description: Table name to list columns for.

name: execute_query
description: Run a single SQL statement against Redshift (SELECT, and INSERT/CREATE TABLE where the database user is permitted). Statements the database user is not permitted to run fail with a permission error.

cluster_type.description: Cluster type reported by list_clusters: provisioned or serverless.

database_name.description: Database to run the query against.
